parsed.explanation: No trans-specific traveller-facing restriction is documented: no presentation offence, no facility ban, no entry policy, and foreign documents face no documented friction (though screening is undocumented — an open question, not an exposure). Positive signals are strong and recent: self-ID marker/name changes, state-funded gender-affirming care, 2020 hate-crime penalties, presidential apology and pride participation, and a prisoner placement policy letting self-identified trans people choose facility (a climate signal, but indicative of institutional culture). Negative signals: documented 2019 case of a trans woman in a men's facility with custodial inaction amid rape, religious opposition halting sex education, 2025 rollback of anti-bullying protocol, stalled conversion-therapy bill, and divisive politics — social friction and partial backsliding, not traveller-facing hostility. No documented targeting of visitors. Sits between the 0.75 anchors (friction, uneven monitoring) and 0.85, tempered by the recent rollback trajectory.
